name: DiscoverU Summer Camps (high school)
org: Kennesaw State University, Continuing and Professional Education
what_you_do: One-week hands-on career camps on campus. The 2026 camps are Baking and Pastry, Chef's Master Class and Medical Skills. The others are AutoCAD, Aerospace Engineering and Adulting 101.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th to 12th graders for camps at the KSU Center. The Aerospace Engineering camp at the Marietta campus takes rising 6th to 12th graders.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: $499 for baking, AutoCAD, Chef's Master Class and Medical Skills; $399 for Adulting 101; $350 for Aerospace Engineering. Scholarships are not mentioned.
deadline_text: 2026 camps ran June 1 to July 24, 2026. Summer 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet; the page has a contact form for updates.
how_to_apply: The 2026 sessions are over, though the page still shows Registration Open labels. For Summer 2027 updates, fill out the contact form on the page. No 2027 dates or registration are posted.
notes: Places: KSU Center, 3333 Busbee Dr NW, Kennesaw. The Marietta campus hosts Aerospace. Contact discoveru@kennesaw.edu or 470-578-6765. It costs money and is not a job. Confirm sign-up status with the team before you pay.
